To: automated call desk / signed: Mara Vale, Head of Retail Operations

The four replacements below supersede the corresponding O-6 entries. Everything else, including the absence of hardship, restructuring, already-paid, notes and callbacks, remains as printed.

(1) Clause 3: ONE wrong answer exhausts security, not three.
(2) Clause 4: read TWENTIETH of NEXT month, unadjusted, for fifteenth.
(3) Clause 5: ZERO persuasion/follow-up attempts. A single flat refusal closes R01; the initial question is not a follow-up attempt. Clarifying a volunteered proposal is still allowed.
(4) Clause 6: ZERO retries. A first unsuccessful create_promise closes R99 and must be described as unsuccessful.

Signed / Mara Vale / 09-10-2026
